en: The 1990 Luzon earthquake was a massive 7.8 magnitude tremor that severely devastated Baguio City.
The famous Chocolate Hills in Bohol are made of thousands of cone-shaped limestone mounds.
The Puerto Princesa Subterranean River National Park features an underground river that flows directly into the sea.
Jupiter's Great Red Spot is a giant, persistent storm that is wider than planet Earth.
Sirius, also known as the Dog Star, is the brightest star visible in the night sky.
NASA's Apollo 11 astronauts landed on the Moon's Sea of Tranquility in July 1969.
An anemometer is a weather instrument specifically designed to measure the speed of the wind.
Baguio City has a tropical highland climate, making it significantly cooler than most Philippine cities.
The fertile volcanic soil around Mount Mayon helps farmers grow abundant crops like abaca and coffee.
Ceres is the largest object in the asteroid belt located between Mars and Jupiter.
Mount Pinatubo's massive 1991 eruption was the second-largest volcanic eruption of the twentieth century.
Nickel is a metallic element mined extensively in the Philippines to make stainless steel.
